legalContentText: Ua hoʻomākaukau maikaʻi ʻia ka ʻike o kēia pūnaewele, akā ʻaʻole hiki iā mākou ke hōʻoiaʻiʻo he piha, pololei a hou paha. Helu ʻia ke kūlana waiwai lehulehu me nā kānāwai i hoʻomaʻalahi ʻia, ʻaʻole ia he ʻōlelo aʻo kānāwai.
legalLinksText: Hoʻopili kēia pūnaewele i nā pūnaewele ʻē aʻe. ʻAʻole mākou e hoʻomalu i ko lākou ʻike a ʻaʻohe o mākou kuleana. Inā ʻike mākou e haki ana kekahi ʻaoʻao loulou i ke kānāwai, e wehe mākou i ka loulou.
legalCopyrightTitle: Kope kuleana a me nā kumu
legalCopyrightText: He waiwai lehulehu nā palapala ma Mouseion a i ʻole hoʻohana ʻia e like me ko lākou laikini. Hōʻike kēlā me kēia hana i kona mau kumu, e like me Wikisource, Perseus Digital Library a me Deutsches Textarchiv (CC BY-SA 4.0). Inā manaʻo ʻoe ʻaʻole pono kekahi palapala ma ʻaneʻi, e pili mai iā mākou.
